notes: All new records remain unread. Existing notes, tags, collections, reading states and attachments were preserved.

Sigmoid Self-Attention PDF is pinned at arXiv v2 (2025-01-22); Langevin/Hopfield at v3 (2026-05-14); LoLCATs at v3 (2025-03-05). Barker is the 2022 version of record, 84(2):496-523, DOI10.1111/rssb.12482, openly obtained from the author institutional repository at UCL.

All new stored PDFs were checked for PDF signature, parsing and source SHA-256 equality. Existing Boltzmann Attention PDF and Z1T HTML snapshot were reused and their managed hashes matched the pre-import snapshot.
Import used the existing official Zotero Connector. No UI focus automation, general HTTP execution service, direct database write or server access was used.
